recognize_zh: D 圖可見成片組織球，細胞質被大量鮮紅色小圓球狀結晶塞滿、核被擠壓；C 圖這些細胞 CD68 陽性，確認為組織球；A、B 腸黏膜的淋巴漿細胞浸潤中漿細胞 κ 輕鏈陽性，提示結晶儲存組織球增生（CSH）合併單株性 B 細胞／漿細胞腫瘤。
features: D (lymph node, H&E): sheets of histiocytes with abundant cytoplasm packed with innumerable small, bright eosinophilic spherical crystals/globules; bland oval nuclei
C (CD68): granular cytoplasmic positivity in the crystal-laden cells, confirming histiocytic lineage; crystals appear as refractile bubbly spheres
A (intestinal mucosa, H&E): lamina propria expanded by a dense lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate separating crypts
B (kappa IHC): numerous kappa-positive plasma cells with strong cytoplasmic staining
No significant cytologic atypia in the histiocytes; crystals are round rather than the classic rhomboid/needle shapes
describe_en: Intestinal mucosal biopsy shows the lamina propria expanded by a dense lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate separating the crypts, with numerous plasma cells showing strong kappa light chain staining. Sections of the mesenteric lymph node show sinuses distended by sheets of histiocytes whose abundant cytoplasm is packed with innumerable small eosinophilic spherical crystals; these cells are CD68-positive. The histiocytes are cytologically bland. Findings are consistent with crystal-storing histiocytosis with unusual spherical crystal morphology, in association with a kappa-restricted extranodal marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation.

ddx.vs: These have granular eosinophilic cytoplasm but are CD68-negative for immunoglobulin crystals and express desmin/myogenin or S100/SOX10 respectively.
Infectious histiocytes contain PAS-positive diastase-resistant (Whipple) or AFB-positive organisms and foamy rather than crystal-packed cytoplasm, without light chain restriction.

ddx.dx: Gaucher cells or other storage disorders
ddx.vs: Gaucher cells show wrinkled tissue-paper cytoplasm with striations rather than discrete bright eosinophilic spheres, and lack an associated clonal B-cell/plasma cell process.
Mott cells are CD138-positive plasma cells with eccentric clock-face nuclei, whereas the crystal-laden cells here are CD68-positive histiocytes.
